description: Turkish Airlines Airbus A330-300 written off in a landing accident at Kathmandu Tribhuvan International on 4 March 2015; the hull was subsequently converted into an aviation museum and a photograph dated 6 November 2017 shows students inside a facility captioned "Aviation Museum" and categorised on Commons under this registration; the museum's exact site and current operating status could NOT be confirmed and the identification rests on that single categorised photograph
